text:
Maria (CS): Quick kickoff: Polaris dedicated bring-up — need to lock quota, autoscale policy, and shadow load window. Who's available next Tue 10-12 PT for a dry-run?
Jamal (SRE): We should validate with a shadow run first, no live traffic. Do we have the target TPS from customer?
Lucas (PM): I can surface numbers. Customer expects ~200 TPS on the short-chat path, bursty patterns at peak. Also they want p95 <= 250ms.
Jamal (SRE): From initial sizing that matches ~120k tokens/min. For autoscale I propose: min_nodes=2, max_nodes=8, cpu_target=65. Example HPA snippet:
```
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
minReplicas: 2
maxReplicas: 8
metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 65
```
Anya (Infra): For priming we need KV cache warmup. Plan: run 100 concurrent warm sessions ramping to 500 over 20m, then run a 60m shadow window. Script is: s3://redwood-team/loadtests/polaris-shadow-v2.py
Maria (CS): Customer insists on zero disruption to production. Schedule canary switch after hours and capture p95 + token-cost delta.
Lucas (PM): Add rollback criteria: >5% increase in 99p error rate OR >10% p95 regression triggers rollback. Also run quality checks against the prompt set: s3://redwood-evals/polaris/quality-checks.json
Jamal (SRE): I'll run a staging smoke tonight with the proposed autoscale settings and report metrics. deploy-bot will post status updates here.
deploy-bot: smoke deploy for polaris-dedicated-autoscale started in staging at 2024-06-21T23:00Z :rocket:
Anya (Infra): Note: set KV cache TTL=12h for the test and disable quantization fallback during warmup so perf is stable.
Maria (CS): Who owns post-run notes and the customer sync?
Lucas (PM): I can own notes + send the checklist. Maria please draft the enablement doc and FAQ.
Maria (CS): On it. I'll include a short runbook and escalation contacts.
Jamal (SRE): After the smoke I'll drop a short spreadsheet with p50/p95/99/token-cost and suggested quota bump. Expect initial numbers by 0400Z.
Lucas (PM): Tagging @Anya to confirm the exact load commands and S3 output paths.
Anya (Infra): Copy — commands I'll run:
```
python loadrunner.py --script polarised_prefix.js --concurrency 100 --ramp 20m --duration 60m --s3-out results/polaris-shadow.json
```
Maria (CS): Thanks team. Blocking Tue 10-12 PT on calendars for dry-run + customer enablement — :thumbsup:
